goal: Prevent abrupt node termination crashes when disk writes fail during block and undo data storage
Ensure failed disk writes trigger diagnostic logging and clean shutdown instead of crashing in destructors
agreement: Substantive support across multiple reviewers with no open objections
Concept approval because turning write failure crashes into normal error handling is a clear win (ryanofsky)
Concept approval based on encountering the same bug during development (w0xlt)
Approvals following addressed feedback on explicit flushes and exception handling (maflcko, sedited)
Open question on what error handling scope should be addressed versus allowed to crash (maflcko)
